role: independent check model for Neural_Adjoint designs (proxy for re-simulation; no CST model of the ADM cell is available)
architecture: Batched deep ensemble (K=4 members in one module) of the V4-exact relational transformer with a global MLP head (EnsV4RelTransformer): per member 1 global (h,p) token + 4 resonator tokens (shared GELU-MLP embedding of ellipse shape-tensor invariants), 4 pre-LN self-attention blocks (d_model 320, 8 heads, FFN 4x) with per-head V4-relation logit biases, mean pool, head concat(global, mean resonator) -> 2x Linear-GELU(1536) -> Linear(2001) emitting all 2001 points at once; output = member mean; 46.25M params. global_standard y scaling, minmax x scaling to [-1,1]. Trained 720 s (292 epochs, best epoch 75) with AdamW lr 1.5e-3, effective weight decay 0.1015, batch 256, dropout 0.02, EMA, grad clip 0.5, fp32/TF32 training, no flip augmentation; evaluated in fp32.
family: 4-member deep ensemble of the V4 relational transformer + global MLP head

selection.rule: best successful run at the final k (= 16000) whose architecture family differs from the final model's (different block type / backbone, not a hyperparameter variant)

candidates_at_final_k.family: 4-member deep ensemble of the V4 relational transformer + global MLP head
4-member deep ensemble of the V4 relational transformer + global MLP head
V4 relational transformer encoder + shared-renderer patch MLP head (no attention decoder)
V4 relational transformer + global MLP head (single model)
4-member deep ensemble of the V4 relational transformer + global MLP head

selection.why: r06_recipe_ens4wd-1106-215908-6c5a (4-member deep ensemble of the V4 relational transformer + global MLP head, val MSE 1.5030e-03) is the lowest-error k=16000 run outside the patch cross-attention encoder-decoder transformer (PatchXAttnTransformer) family. Its decoder is a different block type (a global MLP head emitting all 2001 points, no spectral tokens, no attention over frequency) and it is a 4-member deep ensemble (d_model 320, 4 encoder blocks), trained with a different recipe (fp32/TF32, no flip augmentation, effective weight decay 0.1015). Shared with the final model: the V4-relation-biased geometry-token encoder design and shape-tensor features, and the same D_16000 training split and scalers, so it is an independently trained proxy, not independent data.

interface.loader: forward_model.py: load_forward_model(model_dir: str, device) -> ForwardModel (eval mode)
interface.input: raw geometry g (B, 14) float32 in the order h, p, rx1, rx2, rx3, rx4, ry1, ry2, ry3, ry4, theta1, theta2, theta3, theta4
interface.scaling_inside_model: x_scaled = (g_raw - x_shift) / x_scale ; y_raw = y_model * y_scale + y_shift   (x minmax: x_shift = (x_min + x_max) / 2, x_scale = (x_max - x_min) / 2, i.e. the training range maps to [-1, 1]; y global_standard: y_shift = mean, y_scale = std of all training absorptivity values, the same for all 2001 points)

files.forward_model.py: self-contained model code: network (verbatim copy of the Phase 2 model section) + ForwardModel wrapper + load_forward_model
files.forward_model.pt: dict {format, network_class, in_dim, out_dim, config, state_dict, source_*}; state_dict keys and tensors identical to the source checkpoint
files.scaler.json: x_min, x_max, x_shift, x_scale, y_shift, y_scale, formula

network_config_note: copy for reference; load_forward_model reads the identical copy stored in forward_model.pt and seeds torch with config['seed'] before building the network

export_validation.split: D_k = first k rows of data/processed/pool_{g,s}.npy; validation iff position % 11 == 10
export_validation.precision: fp32, TF32 disabled (cuda.matmul and cudnn), fp64 reduction; eval batch 2048 as the harness

finite_difference_check.precision: float64 copy of the loaded ForwardModel

na_tool_smoke_test.target: validation spectrum #0 of D_k (pool position 10), NOT the Phase 3 target
na_tool_smoke_test.hp: WARMUP_HP (n_init 64, 5 bf16 Adam steps, polish top 8 x 3 fp32 steps)
